ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a half-wave thyristor converter circuit, with an AC power supply on the left, labeled Vm sinωt, and with upper positive and lower negative polarity given; a thyristor is connected in series above; the load on the right is a pure inductor L. Reasoning: The firing angle α = 120°. During thyristor conduction, the pure inductor satisfies L di/dt = Vm sin(ωt). Let θ = ωt, then Lω di/dθ = Vm sin θ. Integrating from i(α)=0 gives i(θ) = (Vm/ωL)(cos α - cos θ). The extinction angle β is the angle at which the current drops to zero again after triggering, therefore cos β = cos α. When α = 120°, the next solution after triggering is β = 360° - 120° = 240°.

raw_record.question_text: A half-wave thyristor converter supplies a purely inductive load, as shown in the figure. If the triggering angle of the thyristor is \(120^{\circ}\), what is the extinction angle?

method.method_draft: First describe the circuit in the image: AC source, series thyristor, and pure inductance L. From the text take α = 120°. During conduction solve L di/dt = Vm sin(ωt), with i(α)=0. Set the resulting current expression to zero to find the next angle at which current ceases; choose the root after 120°, giving β = 240°.

method.method_draft: First describe the circuit in the image as a half-wave thyristor feeding only L. From the text take firing angle α = 120°. Apply inductor volt-second balance over the interval from firing to extinction: the integral of the sinusoidal source voltage across L must be zero when current returns to zero. Use sine-wave area symmetry about 180° to match the area from 120° to 180° with that from 180° to β, yielding β = 240°.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：附件中的电路图显示一个交流正弦电压源，标注为 Vm sinωt，左侧标有正负极性；电源经上方的单个晶闸管/可控硅连接到右侧的电感 L，电感再回到电源，图中没有电阻或其他负载元件。因此该图是半波晶闸管变流器向纯电感负载供电。推理：题目给出触发角 α = 120°。晶闸管从 α 导通到电流降为零的熄灭角 β。对纯电感负载，电流在熄灭时回到零，导通区间内电感电压的伏秒面积必须为零：∫(从 α 到 β) Vm sinθ dθ = 0。去掉常数 Vm，有 [-cosθ](从 120° 到 β)=0，即 cos120° - cosβ = 0，所以 cosβ = cos120°。由于熄灭角应在触发角之后、跨过 180° 的负半周区域，取 β = 360° - 120° = 240°。等价地，120° 到 180° 的正面积与 180° 到 β 的负面积按正弦波关于 180° 对称相等，因此 β = 240°。
